[Problem]{.card-kicker} **K Closest Points to Origin** [LC 973 · K Closest Points to Origin](https://leetcode.com/problems/k-closest-points-to-origin/){difficulty="Medium"}

"Closest $k$" is a **top-$k$ selection** wearing a geometry costume: rank points by squared distance (skip the square root — it is monotone, so $\sqrt{\cdot}$ never changes the order) and keep the best $k$. There are two honest ways, and they trade the same $n$ against $k$: sort everything and slice, or hold a *bounded* heap that never grows past $k$.

[Solved in full in @sec-salgo-p4-a.]{.card-link}
